answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 9417 Country: India Title: I have Bank Loan. So Please tell me I take the Hissa in Bakara id. Question: Asslawalekum My Name is Asif Khan from Panipat. I have Bank Loan. So Please tell me I take the Hissa in Bakara id. Answer ID: 9417 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1252/1252=M/1429) By taking loan, one has to give interest to the bank, whereas taking interest is forbidden likewise giving interest without any exigent compulsion is also haram and sin. It is not clear under which circumstances you have taken the loan. However, you can take share in Qurbani. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
